text.description:
Summary

When you filter the products stock and nothing matches, the "no data" empty-state message is sometimes shown in the wrong language.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the products stock page
2. Apply a filter that matches no products
3. Look at the empty-state message

## Acceptance criteria

Scenario: empty-state language
  Given the products stock list has no rows for the filter
  When I apply a filter that matches nothing
  Then the empty-state message works correctly
